description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the class RequestResponseEndpoint, testing its behavior in handling AMQP messages, link attachments, authorization, message processing, and connection management within the org.eclipse.hono.service.amqp package.

classes.name: RequestResponseEndpointTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying various behaviors of the RequestResponseEndpoint class including link attachment handling, message processing, authorization, response handling, and connection management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock fixtures and common setup for all tests.

methods.name: testOnLinkAttachClosesReceiverUsingAtMostOnceQoS
methods.description: Verifies that a receiver with 'at-most-once' QoS is closed upon link attachment.

methods.name: testOnLinkAttachOpensReceiver
methods.description: Verifies that the receiver is properly opened and configured under normal circumstances.

methods.name: testOnLinkAttachClosesSenderWithoutAppropriateReplyAddress
methods.description: Ensures that a sender lacking a proper reply-to address is closed appropriately.

methods.name: testHandleMessageRejectsMalformedMessage
methods.description: Checks that malformed messages are rejected, and the link is closed with a reject disposition.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForUnauthorizedRequests
methods.description: Verifies that unauthorized requests receive a 403 Forbidden response and are not forwarded to the service.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForTimedOutRequests
methods.description: Verifies that timeouts on request processing result in a 503 Service Unavailable response.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForFailedRequests
methods.description: Checks that internal failures during request processing result in a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseWithStatusCode
methods.description: Helper method to verify correct status code responses for different error scenarios.

methods.name: testHandleMessageSendsResponseForMalformedPayload
methods.description: Ensures that requests with malformed payloads result in a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: testHandleMessageProcessesAuthorizedRequests
methods.description: Test that authorized requests are processed, forwarded, and responses are properly sent back.

methods.name: testDuplicateSubscription
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to attach a second sender to the same reply address results in the second being closed.

methods.name: testFreeSubscription
methods.description: Verifies that a previously closed subscription can be recreated if the connection is re-established.

methods.name: hasStatusCode
methods.description: Utility method to check if a message contains the expected status code.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Factory method that creates a configured instance of RequestResponseEndpoint for testing, with a flag to pass or fail formal verification.
